key_concepts: Earthquakes are caused by geologic forces that break underground rocks and release energy
Seismic waves are energy waves recorded by seismographs
Body waves travel through Earth's interior and include P and S waves
P waves are fastest, longitudinal, push-pull, and travel through solids and fluids
S waves are slower transverse waves that cannot travel through liquids
S waves not passing through the outer core indicates the outer core is liquid
Surface waves travel only through the crust and cause most earthquake destruction
Love waves move the ground side-to-side with horizontal motion
Rayleigh waves roll along the ground and cause most trembling felt
Seismic wave behavior reveals the nature of Earth's interior
